timestamp_policy.small_signal_time: completion proxy of the small reversal bar
timestamp_policy.larger_asof_rule: latest larger bar with completion proxy strictly earlier than the small signal time
timestamp_policy.same_second_policy: excluded from primary strict-timing results; included only in all-proxy sensitivity results
timestamp_policy.session_boundary: 18:00 in the export timestamp's unresolved timezone

definitions.small_reversal: a non-doji small bar whose direction is opposite the immediately preceding non-doji bar in the same session
definitions.pullback: the small reversal follows one or two consecutive opposite-direction small bars
definitions.aligned: small reversal direction equals the latest strictly-prior completed larger-bar direction
definitions.rolling_trend: sign of larger close minus larger close 10 completed larger bars earlier in the same session
definitions.recent_co_reversal: aligned signal occurring within 15 minutes after the first completed larger bar in its current directional run
definitions.large_confirmation: first later larger-chart reversal in the small signal direction
definitions.extended_large_run: at least five consecutive completed larger bars in the current direction
definitions.repeated_countertrend_attempt: second or later small countertrend reversal during the same still-unreversed larger run
